source_note: Farmed from the kenyanstocks.com statement API on 2026-09-21. Every cell is computed: line items carried from the source (0 where absent), group subtotals and statement totals computed by identity. No blanks. H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-cic-2026-ir-hy/): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
